name: Vikunja
description: Self-hosted task management — projects, kanban boards, due dates, labels, and team collaboration
author: Crow

env_vars.name: VIKUNJA_API_TOKEN
env_vars.description: API token from Vikunja Settings > API Tokens

firstAdmin.note: Registration stays open until you turn it off: create your account, then set VIKUNJA_SERVICE_ENABLEREGISTRATION=false.

notes: Self-host via Docker (uses built-in SQLite) or connect to existing (set VIKUNJA_URL + VIKUNJA_API_TOKEN). Create accounts in Vikunja's web UI, then tokens under Settings > API Tokens. The compose derives Vikunja's public URL from VIKUNJA_URL.
